Should flag

Explicit unitless tight leading

This paragraph uses a unitless line height of one, which leaves too little vertical space for a long passage.

Reordered unitless tight leading

This paragraph keeps its tight unitless line height even when font size follows line height in the stylesheet.

Percent line height inherits as a length

This child inherits the parent’s computed percentage line height as a length, which is too small for its larger text.

Em line height inherits as a length

This child inherits the parent’s computed em line height as a length, which is too small for its larger text.

Letter spacing uses local font size

This paragraph declares em letter spacing before its larger font size, so local font size must resolve the spacing.

Should pass

Inherited unitless line height

This paragraph inherits a unitless multiplier and should compute its line height from its own larger font size.

Line height before font size

This paragraph declares a comfortable unitless line height before its larger font size.

Em font size with unitless line height

A relative em font size preserves comfortable unitless leading when declaration order changes.

Percentage font size with unitless line height

A relative percentage font size preserves comfortable unitless leading when declaration order changes.

Rem font size with unitless line height

A relative rem font size preserves comfortable unitless leading when declaration order changes.
